description: This file defines the class EmailsDataAddressCollector, which is responsible for collecting and processing email address data for outgoing emails within the SuiteCRM system. It handles extracting sender and reply-to addresses from inbound email accounts, system email settings, and user addresses, including managing signatures and validation.

classes.name: EmailsDataAddressCollector
classes.description: Main class for collecting and assembling email address data, signatures, and configuration details for email functionality.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the collector with current user and configuration data.

methods.description: Collects email addresses from inbound email accounts, applying signatures and signatures preferences.

methods.description: Validates that the inbound email object is of correct type.

methods.description: Retrieves outbound email settings or sets error if invalid.
